trigger: User successfully completes a purchase transaction
description: Fired when a user checks out and payment is confirmed. Used to track revenue events in Braze and CRM.

order_id.description: Unique identifier for the order (e.g. ORD-12345)

amount.description: Total purchase amount in the specified currency

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP)

items.description: List of purchased items. Each item has product_id, name, quantity, and unit_price

discount_code.description: Promo or discount code applied at checkout, if any

payment_method.description: Payment method used (e.g. credit_card, paypal, apple_pay)
